title: Minute Value of Delay on Wayfare Reserve and Priority Pickup Trips
content:
On a detoured trip of **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)**, the minute-value factor of the delay follows what the rider booked for speed, as the trip's charge entries show.

| Entries on the trip | Minute-value factor |
|---|---|
| a reservation fee entry or a reservation-fee waiver entry (booked through Wayfare Reserve) | 2.0 (reserved minute-value factor) |
| a Priority Pickup charge entry or a Priority Pickup waiver entry, and no reservation fee or reservation-fee waiver entry | 1.5 (priority minute-value factor) |
| neither | not changed |

A trip booked through Wayfare Reserve — it carries a reservation fee or reservation-fee waiver entry — takes the reserved minute-value factor of 2.0. A trip requested with Priority Pickup — it carries a Priority Pickup charge or Priority Pickup waiver entry — that was not reserved takes the priority minute-value factor of 1.5. Any other trip's minute-value factor is not changed.

## Cases (hypothetical trips)

- A reserved trip whose reservation fee was waived under a Wayfare Pass plan (it carries a reservation-fee waiver entry): 2.0.
- A reserved trip that also carries a Priority Pickup entry: 2.0 — the reservation entry decides it.
- An on-demand trip whose Priority Pickup was covered by a Pass allowance (Priority Pickup waiver entry): 1.5.
- An on-demand trip with neither kind of entry: not changed.
